channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rob Pelinka | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rob Pelinka from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on how the Luka Doncic trade went down:

“Dallas wanted Anthony Davis and he was on our team. Conversations started but it was important they remained private….Those conversations started in the beginning of January…Rob Pelinka was able to pull it off all without it leaking to the media because I think Mark Cuban would’ve jumped in front of a train to keep it from happening. Nobody knew including Luka, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James. We had a game in New York that night, the coach knew this was going to happen but he still had to coach the game. It wasn’t a distraction”

Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“He knows the Lakers are building for the future. He understands that, but he values a realistic chance of winning it all. We are very appreciative of the partnership that we've had for eight years with Jeanie [Buss] and Rob [Pelinka] and consider the Lakers as a critical part of his career.”

Rich Paul on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Jun 29, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Danny Ainge, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Sasha Vujačić:

“So anyhow, Rudy (Tomjanovich) says, ‘He played for me before. You’re young. You’re coming from Europe. I think we’ll have a better chance with him.’ And I hadn’t even gotten to the locker room—I already called my agent. My agent at the time was also Kobe’s agent, Rob Pelinka. I was going crazy. They’re telling me, ‘Calm down. You might not be in his plan, but you're in the plan of the franchise.’Then Kobe called me. Kobe calmed me down. I was like, ‘This is crazy.’ Funny fact—one of the teams I was supposed to go to was Boston. Danny Ainge and I had a great workout, and I was like, ‘Damn, do I just kill my dream?’”

Sasha Vujacic on Danny Ainge, Rob Pelinka, Apr 9, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka, Christian Wood
item.description:
Ham told Andscape recently.

“I was on him. And then I was just checking on [Wood], letting him know, man, ‘We here, bro and we have an opportunity to do some good s—… “But [Pelinka] responded well. And finally, we bagged [Wood] up and he has been great.”

Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka, Christian Wood, Oct 13, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“I worked Rob Pelinka. I didn’t call him every day. It was every other day with calls, texts,”

Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka, Oct 13, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“In my first deal, I definitely did the Lakers a little favor to have the hometown discount. I always appreciate (Lakers vice president of basketball operations) Rob Pelinka for the deal that he gave me, because it gave me security and it gave me a player option. I was one of the few players in NBA history without being a lottery pick to have a player option in an extension. Everything has worked out in my favor from signing that deal to my progression as a player to this summer too.”

Kyle Kuzma on Rob Pelinka, Dec 6, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Paul, who also represents the Lakers’ Anthony Davis, told The Athletic.

“And I don’t think that’s who we are, who LeBron is. We have a great partnership with the Lakers. The Klutch Sports Group and the Lakers don’t have an issue. Rich Paul and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. LeBronJames and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. And Jeanie Buss and LeBron and Rich Paul don’t have an issue. It’s very simple. Very simple. So, you know, whoever put that type of stuff out, and people run with it, I think it’s unfair to the Lakers.”

Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka, Feb 26, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Frank Vogel on NBA trade deadline conversations with Rob Pelinka:

“I keep those conversations private. If there's ways we can improve our team, we're going to do it.”

Frank Vogel on Rob Pelinka, Feb 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Linda Rambis
item.description:
Anthony Davis:

“I just wanted to take the process one day at a time. Obviously winning the championship with L.A. was very great. The team Rob (Pelinka) put together, and Jeanie (Buss) put together, and Linda (Rambis) and all the people in the front office was amazing, and we did something special. Especially with everything going on in 2020.I don’t think there was a doubt that I was gonna come back, it was just trying to figure out the logistics and what was best for me and my family, and I was able to get a deal done today.”

Anthony Davis on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Linda Rambis, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Silverscreenandroll.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
LeBron on Rob Pelinka (1/2):

“What gave me faith is thatRob Pelinka told me he would do whatever it takes to make sure that we would become a winning franchise once again. Obviously, championships are not promised, and I don't expect that..”

LeBron James on Rob Pelinka, Oct 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Anthony Davis on being snubbed for Defensive Player of the Year, LeBron James snubbed MVP and Rob Pelinka voted 7th for exec of year:

“That's kind of been a thing this year...but if we are able to win one more game then no one cares about the awards. We will all be champions.”

Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Rob Pelinka, Oct 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
The Los Angeles Lakers plan to reward guard Avery Bradley, who opted out of the NBA’s restart, with a championship ring this season if the franchise is able to capture its 17th NBA title.

“Yes, [Lakers general manager] Rob Pelinka made me aware of the Lakers offering me a ring if they win the championship,”

Avery Bradley on Rob Pelinka, Jul 7, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Vanessa Bryant, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“I get home and just… started crying. It was hard to find words, I couldn’t talk to anyone for days. The only person I talked to was Robert (Pelinka). He was the first I had the strength to talk to, just to know what was going on, what happened and who else was there, how was Vanessa (Bryant), how were the kids. Basically, I didn’t leave the house,”

Pau Gasol on Vanessa Bryant, Rob Pelinka, Feb 14, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Magic Johnson:

“Rob [Pelinka] & I, when we were there, we worked well together, but the little things that were going on behind the scenes, that bothered me.”

Magic Johnson on Rob Pelinka, May 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Pelinka remains with the Lakers as general manager.

“I didn’t like those things [Pelinka] was saying behind my back, that I wasn’t in the office enough,”

Magic Johnson on Rob Pelinka, May 21, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Elton Brand on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“[Lakers general manager]Rob Pelinka called me and said 'Hey, we're hearing Ben wants to talk to Hall of Famers, championship-level players, and Magic is on the list. We need authorization for him to meet up.' And I said 'No.'This is over a month ago, so I said no,”

Elton Brand on Rob Pelinka, Feb 11, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Elton Brand on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Adrian Wojnarowski:Elton Brand tells ESPN:

“No issue. I have a great relationship with Ben and Rich (Paul) and we expect him to be a Sixer for a long time. He has taken interest in chatting with some of the game's all-time greats and we're supportive. I had brief dialogue with Rob Pelinka who I've known for a long time, but nothing is planned. Our collective focus is on making a postseason push. Again, we're not sweating this, end of story.”

Elton Brand on Rob Pelinka, Feb 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Wade said of the gesture.

“I wanted to thank Rob Pelinka, Magic, Jeanie Buss. Just the whole Laker front office and Laker Nation for allowing that to happen. I did not expect that. That was so cool. I looked over and saw my wife beaming. It was great. I appreciate them for giving me that moment.”

Dwyane Wade on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Dec 11, 2018. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
The team’s revamped braintrust, Bryant believes, is the key to their turnaround.

“I mean Rob (Pelinka) is one of the smartest guys I've ever met in my life, and he is going to figure this thing out,”

Kobe Bryant on Rob Pelinka, Apr 14, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Kuzma on the message from Magic, Pelinka and Walton:

“They don’t want me to be average, they want me to be a great player,as I want to be. The message was work as hard as possible.”

Kyle Kuzma on Rob Pelinka, Apr 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Luke Walton on Magic Johnson, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Luke Walton:

“As I preach to my players that control what you can control in life, that has to be my philosophy as a coach as well... [Team president Magic Johnson and general manager Rob Pelinka] have been great, they have been supportive. They obviously understand where we are at as a team and what we are trying to do and what the big picture is…”

Luke Walton on Magic Johnson, Rob Pelinka, Jan 5, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jordan Clarkson on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Serena Winters:Jordan Clarkson on Magic & Rob Pelinka:

“You just feel so open to them... They want to help you so much. They want to hear our ideas.”

Jordan Clarkson on Rob Pelinka, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Magic Johnson, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“I hope Magic Johnson and Rob Pelinka go down as the worst GM/President combination in the history of GM/President combinations. But I hope they live wonderful lives.”

Mark Cuban on Magic Johnson, Rob Pelinka, Mar 7, 2017. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Jerry Zgoda:Tyus Jones on his agent Rob Pelinka becoming the Lakers' new GM:

“I’m really happy for him. It's just something he had to do.”

Tyus Jones on Rob Pelinka, Feb 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @JerryZgoda.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Eric Gordon:

“(Pelinka) is going to be the GM of the Lakers. He's going to be good. I expect nothing but good things. He knows basketball.”

Eric Gordon on Rob Pelinka, Feb 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Trevor Ariza on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Calvin Watkins:Trevor Ariza on Pelinka:

“I think he'll be unbelievable in that role. He knows basketball. He has a really, really good eye for talent.”

Trevor Ariza on Rob Pelinka, Feb 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @calvinwatkins.

item.title: Billy Hunter on Kobe Bryant, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Hunter then makes a leap in his declaration to the court, characterizing Bryant's phone call as evidence that Fisher had cut a 50-50 deal with the owners without Hunter's knowledge or authority.

“What Bryant and Pelinka were telling me is that a 50-50 deal had already been completed behind my back,”

Billy Hunter on Kobe Bryant, Rob Pelinka, Nov 21, 2013. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“I would suspect that at some point this season, we’ll sit down, whether it be Kobe and I, or Kobe and his representative, Rob Pelinka, and talk about the future,”

Mitch Kupchak on Rob Pelinka, Sep 30, 2013. Source: Boston Globe.
